h1. inventory-sync runbook

Owned by team supply (erin, frank). Alerts go to #supply-alerts; incidents are discussed in #incidents.

h2. Known failure modes

h3. UpstreamSchemaDrift
Symptom: log lines containing 'UpstreamSchemaDrift: unexpected field in warehouse feed' from ingest_feed().
Check: error rate panel for service=inventory-sync; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of inventory-sync; if persists, page supply on-call.

h3. StaleSnapshot
Symptom: log lines containing 'StaleSnapshot: snapshot older than threshold' from publish_snapshot().
Check: error rate panel for service=inventory-sync; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of inventory-sync; if persists, page supply on-call.

h2. Dashboards
Chronosphere: rate(http_requests_total{service="inventory-sync",code=~"5.."}[5m])
